changelog: 🩹 Fixed black screen crash at the end of multi-episode binge playback (countdown card bug)
🛡️ New renderer-crash guard: if the video engine dies the app now recovers itself instead of staying black
🚪 Back button escape hatch: 3 quick Back presses always return you to the Home screen, even if the app is stuck
🚀 Memory optimization: OS low-memory cache pruning for uninterrupted long streaming sessions
📺 Restored Sony channels (SET HD, Sony SAB, Sony Pal, Sony BBC Earth, Sony Sports Ten 1) with verified live streams
🛡️ Fixed dead channel filtering so Indian and Sony channel tiles are never hidden from the Live TV grid
⚡ Invalidated stale channel cache and reduced failure cooldown to 10 minutes
🩹 Fixed Settings recovery screen crash ('installedVersion is not defined')
💥 CRITICAL FIX: Fire TV / Android TV stick no longer freezes the whole device — video buffer is now capped to your stick's memory so the system never runs out of RAM
🛡️ New renderer-crash guard: if the app's video engine dies it recovers automatically instead of showing a dead black screen
🚪 Escape hatch: 3 quick Back presses always background the app so Home stays reachable — no more pulling the power plug
🩹 Fixed end-of-episode binge crash that black-screened the player
🪟 Ad popup windows now blocked at the native layer
